note: 1.20.1 TexturedButtonWidget (class_344) took a texture Identifier plus atlas u/v/texWidth/texHeight; 1.21.1 takes WidgetSprites (whole GUI sprites) and can no longer express an atlas sub-region. LegacyTexturedButton keeps the old constructor and re-implements the old quad+label drawing, so icons keep their original look instead of showing a missing sprite.
